gaps: No mediated FCV chain is assembled: coastal-user conflicts are participation/governance context without a documented climate trigger.
Multi-hazard parish composites must not be presented as climate-specific rankings or household risk measurements.

executive_assessment.text: Parish-level composite vulnerability and capacity differ from direct flood exposure; coastal transport examples name Speightstown, Holetown, Bridgetown and Oistins.
Beryl evidence identifies fishing assets and women processors/vendors as affected, while recovery accounts and proposed infrastructure support do not demonstrate restored incomes.
Coastal participation and enforcement weaknesses are dated institutional findings. No supported climate-violence or reverse-FCV pathway was found in the reviewed sources.
